name: DNA damage inducible transcript 3

function.text: DDIT3 encodes CHOP, a stress-responsive transcription factor that participates in endoplasmic-reticulum stress signaling and regulation of cellular differentiation and apoptosis.

function.text: DDIT3 encodes CHOP, a C/EBP-family transcription factor activated during endoplasmic-reticulum stress. It can form heterodimers with other C/EBP proteins and inhibit their DNA-binding activity. The protein participates in adipocyte and erythroid differentiation and can promote apoptosis, connecting a cellular stress response with changes in transcription and cell fate.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving DDIT3 have been reported in liposarcoma and GLI1-altered mesenchymal tumor, malignant/metastasizing.
